entries.claim: The new empty-body arm treats any string containing only whitespace as a successfully inspected empty range, but a string value does not establish that Git produced a trustworthy diff for the requested range.
entries.failure_scenario: A caller-controlled Git diff environment can select an external diff/textconv helper that exits successfully while emitting no output (or only whitespace) for a changed file containing a secret or destructive change. `scanDiff` then returns `checked: true`, `inconclusive: false`, and `empty: true`; `cmdRiskCheckRun` persists that as a completed record and `risk-check status` accepts it as `recorded`. Before this change the same output was fail-closed as unchecked/inconclusive. The empty-success path must be restricted to a verified ordinary Git empty-range result, or the diff invocation must disable external/textconv output sources and distinguish command provenance from an empty string.
